author: Wynne Progress
title: New Wynne High School opening likely delayed until 2027-28 school year - NewsBreak
text:
By Wynne Progress ,
1 days ago WYNNE — The new Wynne High School likely will not be ready for classes before the end of the 2026-27 school year, according to Superintendent Dr. Kenneth Moore. “We are trying our best to try to let the seniors have some things over there. It doesn’t look like we’re going to transition the whole school over even if it’s May,” Moore said. “The issue with that is we’re in the middle of testing. That is an absolute nightmare to try to move any grade, staff, everybody over there right in the middle of testing. You know how it’s going to be. You’re always going to have hiccups when you first move into a new building. As the doors open, there’s just things that happen.” Read full article
